about_the_game:
Create a New You

Begin each life with a blank slate or lean into the legacy of your past selves. Use a deep character creation system to define your look, your personality, and your starting traits. Whether you’re a fashion-forward influencer, a brooding poet with a past, or a time-traveling rockstar, each life is an opportunity to reinvent yourself.

Over time, heirlooms, memories, and story paths carry forward across lives, giving you the chance to build a multiverse of “you”, and uncover just how weird and wonderful your timeline can become.

One Life. One Hour. A Hundred Possibilities.

Every life in 100 Lives is shaped by the decisions you make. Will you crush your first concert… or lose it in a battle of wits with a demon? Take part in slice-of-life moments, surprise encounters, and turning-point events across a sprawling interactive map.

With hundreds of scenarios at your fingertips, from courtroom drama to moon landings, no two lives play out the same. But each one changes the map of what comes next.

Discover and Grow Your Skills

As you experience more lives, your Tree of Life expands. Learn new skills, from stand-up comedy to martial arts, devil-slaying to diplomacy, and watch your capabilities grow across timelines.

Skills unlock new options during events, influence how characters respond to you, and open entirely new story branches. Every skill you master makes your next life more unpredictable… and more exciting.

Build Real Relationships Across Lives

Meet people who change everything: friends, lovers, enemies, mentors, rivals. Some relationships begin and end in a single hour. Others stretch across timelines, reappearing when you least expect them.

Your actions define how others see you. Will you build trust, spark romance, or ignite chaos? Every relationship is a new story, and you never know who might come back in your next life.

Watch the World Evolve

Your lives don’t just shape you; they shape the world. As you move from one life to the next, you’ll watch the world map shift in response to your actions. Cities rise, new regions unlock, and old choices echo across time.

With themed seasons, community-driven events, and surprise developments woven into the metagame, the universe of 100 Lives is constantly evolving. You’re not just living in it, you’re helping shape it.

 

Your journey doesn’t end with one life. In 100 Lives, it’s only just beginning.

Wishlist now and prepare to start over… again and again.

Want the inside scoop on Kingstown’s weirdest moments?

  • Join Discord – share theories, pitch timelines, uncover secrets

  • Follow on TikTok – gossip, conspiracies, cryptid sightings

  • Follow on Instagram – life advice, glitchy moments, questionable “facts”

Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX or OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX or OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: 100 Lives is a fast-paced life simulation roguelike where every hour is a brand-new lifetime. Shape your identity, chase your dreams, and face the unexpected; all before the clock runs out. In each life, your choices define who you become, and your past decisions ripple forward in surprising ways.
